title: Aspiration-based Perturbed Learning Automata in Games with Noisy Utility Measurements. Part A: Stochastic Stability in Non-Zero-Sum Games
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical and theoretical analysis of stochastic stability in game-theoretic learning algorithms (specifically APLA). While it discusses cooperative games like the Prisoner's Dilemma and the Stag-Hunt game, its purpose is to analyze algorithmic convergence and stability, not to benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
